entries.zh: 屋后马厩里传来了一声轻柔的马嘶。

entries.en: The story reveals the trusted adviser as the betrayer.
entries.zh: 故事揭示了那位受信任的顾问正是背叛者。

entries.en: The account describes a passenger found insensible after the accident.
entries.zh: 这份记述描述了一名事故后被发现失去知觉的乘客。

entries.en: The physician recorded laryngitis as a possible cause of the hoarseness.
entries.zh: 医生记录了喉炎可能是声音嘶哑的原因。

entries.en: The museum display emphasizes the specialness of each donated object.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展示强调了每件捐赠物品的特殊性。

entries.en: The poem contrasts fleshly pleasures with spiritual aspirations.
entries.zh: 这首诗将肉体享乐与精神追求作了对比。

entries.en: The booking form requires prepayment before a room can be confirmed.
entries.zh: 预订表要求先付款，才可确认房间预订。

entries.en: The reviewer wrote a rhapsodic account of the concert.
entries.zh: 评论者满怀狂喜地描述了这场音乐会。

entries.en: The circuit diagram includes a resistive element beside the capacitor.
entries.zh: 电路图在电容器旁画有一个电阻元件。

entries.en: The team revised the workflow to reduce repeated data entry.
entries.zh: 团队修改了工作流程，以减少重复的数据录入。

entries.en: The surveyor checked the plat before marking the boundary.
entries.zh: 测量员在标记边界前核对了地块图。

entries.en: The narrator sends a long letter to his pater.
entries.zh: 叙述者给父亲寄了一封长信。

entries.en: The technician inspected the aerator in the treatment tank.
entries.zh: 技术员检查了处理池中的曝气器。

entries.en: The gardener compared hydroponic cultivation with growing plants in soil.
entries.zh: 园丁比较了水耕栽培与在土壤中种植植物。

entries.en: The residents complained about the intrusiveness of the repeated surveys.
entries.zh: 居民们抱怨反复调查对生活造成侵扰。

entries.en: The astronomer pointed out a familiar asterism in the evening sky.
entries.zh: 天文学家指出了夜空中一个熟悉的星群。

entries.en: The narrator doubts that anyone can preordain another person's future.
entries.zh: 叙述者怀疑是否有人能预先决定另一个人的未来。

entries.en: The cafe served minestrone with a slice of bread.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆端上了蔬菜通心粉汤，并配了一片面包。

entries.en: The baby laughed during a game of peekaboo.
entries.zh: 宝宝在玩躲躲猫游戏时笑了起来。

entries.en: The damp air gave her hair an unruly frizz.
entries.zh: 潮湿的空气让她的头发变得鬈曲蓬乱。

entries.en: The farmer stacked the fresh bales in the hayloft.
entries.zh: 农民把新草捆堆进了干草阁楼。

entries.en: The diagram shows the nerve passing distally toward the hand.
entries.zh: 示意图显示了神经朝手的方向向远端延伸的走向。

entries.en: The old violin sounded wondrously clear after the repair.
entries.zh: 修复后，这把旧小提琴的声音清亮得令人惊叹。

entries.en: The proposal included a surtax on the highest incomes.
entries.zh: 这项提案包括对最高收入征收附加税。

entries.en: The anatomy lesson identified the buccal surface of the tooth.
entries.zh: 解剖课指出了牙齿的颊面。

entries.en: The clinician reviewed the urinalysis before completing the report.
entries.zh: 临床医生在完成报告前查看了尿液分析结果。

entries.en: The carpenter measured the unevenness of the floor.
entries.zh: 木匠测量了地板的不平整程度。

entries.en: The physiology lecture discussed oxytocin among several hormones.
entries.zh: 生理学讲座讨论了包括催产素在内的几种激素。

entries.en: The research protocol lists radioimmunoassay as the measurement method.
entries.zh: 研究规程将放射免疫测定列为测量方法。

entries.en: The newsboy left a paper at each doorway.
entries.zh: 报童在每个门口留了一份报纸。

entries.en: The barber struggled to flatten a stubborn cowlick.
entries.zh: 理发师费力地想压平一绺顽固翘起的头发。

entries.en: The old lane still had a rough macadam surface.
entries.zh: 这条旧巷仍铺着粗糙的碎石路面。

entries.en: The essay examines the popularization of science through radio.
entries.zh: 这篇文章考察了通过广播普及科学的做法。

entries.en: The historian analyzed the dehumanization expressed in the propaganda.
entries.zh: 历史学家分析了宣传中体现的非人化倾向。

entries.en: The shared garden encouraged neighborliness among the residents.
entries.zh: 共用花园促进了居民之间的邻里友善。

entries.en: The guest continued to blather long after the question had been answered.
entries.zh: 问题回答完很久以后，客人还在喋喋不休地说废话。
